description:
About Winona:

Winona is one of the leading telemedicine companies providing HRT for women in menopause. We’ve built all of our technology in-house including an EHR, patient care admin system, patient portal, website, marketing technology etc. Winona has two compounding pharmacies and a team of in-house physicians providing world-class care via a fully vertically integrated business model.

 

About the Role:

We’re looking for an experienced Email Designer with a strong background in email design, HTML email development, responsive design principles, and email platform limitations. The ideal candidate is highly proficient in Figma and experienced designing emails for platforms such as Iterable, Klaviyo, and similar email marketing tools, with a strong command of visual hierarchy, typography, brand consistency, and conversion-focused design. You’ll translate creative briefs into polished, high-performing emails across desktop and mobile devices, build and maintain reusable templates and modular design systems, and ensure every design is optimized for accessibility, usability, and compatibility across major email clients.

Seniority Level: Mid Level

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Translate creative briefs into polished, engaging email designs.

  • Build reusable templates and modular components, and maintain email design systems.

  • Ensure designs are optimized for accessibility, usability, and compatibility across major email clients.

  • Design for both desktop and mobile, applying responsive and mobile-first principles.

  • Apply email marketing best practices, including CTA placement, personalization, A/B testing, and performance optimization.

  • Collaborate with lifecycle marketing, copywriting, and development teams, incorporating feedback throughout the design process.

  • Manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

  • Maintain a high standard of quality through thorough design QA.

 

Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience specifically in email design, with a portfolio that includes email campaigns, templates, and responsive email designs. General graphic or web design experience alone is not sufficient.

  • Advanced proficiency in Figma.

  • Experience with email marketing platforms such as Iterable, Klaviyo, or Mailchimp.

  • Familiarity with HTML/CSS for email development. (Experience developing HTML emails is a plus, but not required.)

  • Strong understanding of email design best practices, responsive and mobile-first design, HTML email limitations, and email client compatibility (Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, etc.).

  • Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, typography, accessibility standards, and conversion-focused design.

  • Experience with modular email design systems, reusable components, dynamic content, personalization, A/B testing, and email performance optimization.

  • Familiarity with lifecycle marketing strategies, customer journeys, and designing for different campaign types, including promotional, transactional, and automated email flows.

  • Proficient and comfortable using AI-powered design and productivity tools to streamline workflows and improve efficiency, with a willingness to continuously explore new AI capabilities.

  • Familiarity with project management tools (ClickUp, Asana, or similar).

  • Must be available to start as soon as possible, with no extended planned PTO between January and March.

What’s in it for you?

As a full-time independent contractor, you’ll enjoy:

  • Remote-first, work wherever you choose

  • Unlimited paid time off

  • Paid non-working holidays per country of residence

  • Pro-rated 13th-month bonus in select regions

  • Referral bonuses

  • Financial support for online courses

  • Fun and casual work environment

  • Employee engagement activities and virtual gatherings

  • We are a diverse, global team! 🌍

 

Equal Employment Opportunity

Winona provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, national origin, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected classification. Equal employment opportunity extends to all aspects of employment including, but not limited to, recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, demotion, transfer, leaves of absence, and termination. Winona takes allegations of discrimination, harassment, and retaliation seriously and will promptly investigate such behaviors.
